title: Cosmic Eye Nebula
description: A massive surreal eye dominates the composition, its iris replaced by a vibrant swirling cosmic orb with yellow, green, and blue hues. The eye is surrounded by colorful nebulae, floating planets, and swirling rings, set against a dark starry space background with a golden dripping sky above and abstract red and green forms below.
prompt: Surreal cosmic eye floating in space, its iris transformed into a glowing multicolored swirling planet with yellow green blue vortex, surrounded by vibrant pink purple nebulae, floating orbs and spiral rings, dramatic golden dripping sky above dark cloudy horizon, abstract red and green organic forms in foreground, highly detailed psychedelic fantasy art
